name: Oohara Ryouka
source:
An elite competent boss. A married woman. She is cool and stoic about her work, but she also loves her subordinates and is well-liked. 

Her husband is her former boss. They respect each other as workaholics, but because of that, they haven't seen each other for a long time, and she feels lonely inside.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/majimehitozuma.html]official site[/url]]
